grammar.summary: 本课讲述清洁工隐瞒身份的故事，集中运用比较结构 far more...than 与 only half as much as、such...that 倒装句式，以及 be referred to as（被称为）与 will be doing 将来进行时，突出身份与收入的对比。

points.title: 比较结构 (Comparative Structures)
points.explanation: 用 more...than、as much as、half as much as 等比较不同对象。本课先以 far more money than 对比体力劳动者与办公室人员的收入，结尾又用 will be earning only half as much as he used to 对比艾尔弗换工作前后的收入，比较结构贯穿全文。

examples.en: people who do manual work often receive far more money than people who work in offices.
examples.cn: 从事体力劳动的人的收入一般要比坐办公室的人高出许多。

examples.en: He will be earning only half as much as he used to
examples.cn: 他将来挣的钱只有他现在的一半。

points.title: such 倒装句 (Inversion with such)
points.explanation: Such is/was + 主语 + that... 是强调句式，把 such 置于句首形成倒装，意为「……如此，以至于……」。本课用 Such is human nature, that a great many people are often willing... 强调「人之常情就是这样」，突出普遍心理。

examples.en: Such is human nature, that a great many people are often willing to sacrifice higher pay for the privilege of becoming white-collar workers.
examples.cn: 许多人常常情愿放弃较高的薪水以换取做白领工人的殊荣，此乃人之常情。

points.title: be referred to as 被称为 (Passive 'referred to as')
points.explanation: be referred to as + 名词，意为「被称为、被称作」，是 refer to sb/sth as 的被动式，用于介绍名称或身份。本课用 are frequently referred to as 'white-collar workers' 说明「坐办公室的人常被称作白领工人」。

examples.en: People who work in offices are frequently referred to as "white-collar workers' for the simple reason that they usually wear a collar and tie to go to work.
examples.cn: 坐办公室的之所以常常被称作“白领工人”，就是因为他们通常是穿着硬领白衬衫，系着领带去上班。

exercises.q: people who do manual work often receive ______ money than people who work in offices.
People who work in offices are frequently ______ as 'white-collar workers'.
______ is human nature, that a great many people are often willing to sacrifice higher pay for the privilege of becoming white-collar workers. 此句采用的句式是______。
用比较结构填空：He will be earning only half ______ much as he used to.（写出空缺词）
He will soon be working in an office. 句中 will be working 是______。
